headline: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as attacks on shipping increase
summary: A Singaporean container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by a projectile. All 21 crew members were safely evacuated, as attacks on shipping increase.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so attacks there affect energy transport costs and supply risk.
why_moved: The input reports increasing attacks on shipping in the strait, with a container ship sunk after being hit by a projectile.
